jobs.title: Underground Structures Lead - Construction
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, UAE, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: The Underground Structures Expert will play a pivotal role in the design, construction, and management of underground infrastructure for the UAE's high-speed rail network. This position requires expertise in tunneling, underground station design, and structural engineering in densely populated urban environments. The expert will ensure the integration of technical solutions that meet project requirements, safety standards, and environmental considerations. Design and Engineering: Lead the design and development of underground structures, including tunnels, underground stations, and intervention shafts. Develop solutions for tunnel boring machine (TBM) drives, launch and retrieval locations, and ventilation shafts. Ensure compliance with international standards such as AASHTO LRFD and Eurocodes. Construction Supervision: Oversee construction activities, ensuring adherence to design specifications and timelines. Manage contractor submissions and verify structural designs for bridges, culverts, and other underground elements. Safety and Risk Management: Implement fire and life safety strategies for underground rail infrastructure. Address challenges related to emergency egress, ventilation, and space constraints in urban areas. Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinate with government agencies, military, and private stakeholders to address land availability and alignment challenges. Develop solutions to minimize the impact of construction on local communities and ecological habitats. Technical Leadership: Provide guidance on the selection of construction methodologies, such as cut-and-cover and mined tunneling. Leverage lessons learned from global high-speed rail projects to optimize design and construction processes.   Technical Expertise: Extensive experience in tunneling methods such as TBM (Tunnel Boring Machine),  and cut-and-cover techniques. Proficiency in structural analysis and design software, such as STAAD Pro, SAP2000, and AutoCAD Civil 3D. Knowledge of geotechnical engineering principles, including soil-structure interaction and ground improvement techniques. High-Speed Rail Knowledge: Involvement in previous high-speed rail projects, including station design, track alignment, and underground facilities. Familiarity with electrification systems, signaling, and rolling stock integration. Project Management: Experience managing large-scale infrastructure projects, including budget control, resource allocation, and risk mitigation. Coordination with multidisciplinary teams, including architects, engineers, and contractors. Regional Experience: Understanding of UAE-specific challenges, such as extreme heat, sand infiltration, and urban density constraints. Experience navigating regulatory frameworks and collaborating with local authorities. Safety and Environmental Standards: Implementation of fire and life safety measures for underground rail systems. Expertise in sustainable construction practices and minimizing environmental impact.

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Maintain accurate and complete quality records, photographs and supporting documentation for each inspection. Support the preparation of quality documentation and test/inspection packages for handover and close-out. Coordination & Compliance Liaise with contractor quality teams to coordinate inspection requests, hold/witness points and inspection scheduling. Coordinate with the design/engineering team on non-conformances, technical queries and any deviations requiring clarification or approval. Support internal and external quality audits and inspections, providing records and evidence as required. Report inspection findings, quality trends and recurring issues to the QA/QC Manager, escalating significant quality concerns promptly. Ensure compliance with the project Quality Management Plan, applicable codes/standards and contractual quality requirements at all times. Promote a quality-first culture on site and support contractor personnel in understanding and meeting quality requirements. Minimum Qualifications & Experience The following are the mandatory minimum requirements for this position: Minimum of five (5) years’ inspection or site supervision experience. Knowledge of construction quality procedures. Middle East / UAE experience is highly advantageous. Rail experience is preferable. University degree, or demonstrated equivalent experience in civil engineering / inspection.

This role leads the growth function for Careem Food in Dubai and, by extension, UAE.     • Design growth initiatives end-to-end across user acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetisation.

Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the team

Careem Grocery is reinventing how people shop for groceries, pharmacy, and everyday essentials, on-demand, in minutes. We're a startup within a startup: a small, high-conviction team operating at speed, with real ownership over outcomes. We're building the supply chain infrastructure that makes that promise possible, and we're looking for someone to own the demand side of it.

About the role

This is a senior individual contributor and cross-functional leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable writing a SQL query, challenging a commercial team's promo forecast, and presenting supply risk to a VP. You'll own demand planning end-to-end; from statistical modelling to S&OP facilitation and you'll be expected to build and improve the systems, not just run them.

  • Forecasting & Modelling - Build and maintain demand forecasting models across SKUs, categories, and dark store locations. Go beyond Excel — leverage statistical methods (time series, regression, ML-assisted forecasting) and own the tooling decisions that get us there. You should be comfortable pulling your own data in SQL and sense-checking model outputs against ground truth.
  • Demand Variability & Scenario Planning - Develop frameworks to manage volatility from seasonality, promotions, new product launches, and macroeconomic signals. Run scenario models before they become supply crises.
  • S&OP Process Leadership - Own the weekly and monthly S&OP cadence. Facilitate cross-functional alignment across commercial, ops, and logistics. Surface gaps early, propose solutions, and drive decisions, not just document them.
  • Inventory Optimisation - Set and monitor inventory targets by SKU and location to balance availability against holding cost and waste. Work closely with category and logistics teams to design replenishment logic that performs at quick commerce speed.
  • Data & Tooling- You'll be hands-on with data. Write and maintain SQL queries for demand signals, build dashboards that non-technical stakeholders can act on, and explore AI/ML tooling to improve forecast accuracy. If a process can be automated, you'll be the one to build the case and execute it.
  • Insight & Communication - Translate complex demand signals into clear narratives for senior leadership. Forecast updates, variance analysis, risk flags — you own the story and the numbers behind it.
